_readme: reverse engineered from DailyDoKit::SetRules in the ARM64 decompile
(datainfo/decomp/ghidra, function at 0x00469e60, 2540 decompiled lines).
see datainfo/README.md for the full writeup - this file is the data,
that is the story of how it was pulled out
confirmed mechanism: a RaptRandom prng is seeded once with MonthlySeed(0),
so its output is identical for every player for the whole calendar month.
gametype.id is chosen as pool[App::GetNowDay(0) % 35], where pool is a
35-slot array filled from that same monthly-seeded stream - so which of
the 5 tournament modes plays on a given day shifts across the month but
is exactly the same for everyone. the individual rule modifiers below are
each rolled independently off the same RNG stream (RaptRandom::Get calls
scattered through SetRules, e.g. 'if (RaptRandom::Get(gRandom,2)==1)'),
so the day's full rule set is deterministic but not literally one index
into one list - more like a sequence of coin flips that everyone gets in
the same order that day
confidence per rule: 'confirmed' means the id-to-icon link was read
directly off a code path (id 20's special two-layer icon draw, or the
icon filename itself for 28/29). 'inferred' means matched by reading the
icon's artwork against the rule text - the exact numeric id for those is
a best guess, not something pulled from a pointer offset
confirmed custom markup tags used in these panels, defined once per
panel via <define>:
<color r,g,b>  or  <color name>   - e.g. <color 0,1,0>, <color gold>
<_tc>     default readable text colour (rgba .8,.8,1,.85)
<blinky>  colour-cycling emphasis for the key phrase in a rule
<_stinky> red/yellow blinking warning variant, seen on stinky-lock text
, ,
icon files: apk/assets/images/UI_DYNA/DDGameType_Icon[00-04].png,
DDRules_Icon[05-29].png, DDBonus_Icon[IMG_000-003].png

rules._readme: optional modifiers layered on top of the day's gametype, ddrule_icon%d

list.text: There will be LOTS of Fat Chuzzles in play!
You only score points with matches of FOUR OR MORE!
Matching five or more Chuzzles in one group will grant you an extra move!
Locks tend to appear on the row you last moved!
Some Chuzzles will start in a Gacha ball!
A lock will fall in at the end of each move!
Sometimes a Mystery Chuzzle will fall in!
Any time you make a combo, a lock will fall in!
Matches of four or more Chuzzles bring in a lock!
Any time you make a chain reaction, a lock will fall in!

list.note: plain white/tintable chuzzle silhouette, layered under icon 16 and dynamically recoloured via <color %s> with a random gChuzzleColors entry - this is what actually makes rule 20 read as 'rainbow'
drawn together with icon 15 for rule id 20 (see above)

list.text: All scores are multiplied by the number of locks on the board!
You only score points if you make a COMBO!
Chain reactions don't give any bonus!

list.note: the only rule with a directly-traced id: code checks 'if (ruleId == 0x14)' and draws icon 16 then icon 15 tinted with a random chuzzle colour before the text
list.text: Rainbow Chuzzles are in play!  Match them for a big bonus that grows each time!
Combo matches create a Rainbow Chuzzle!
Chain reactions create a Rainbow Chuzzle!
Pop the same color over and over for a HUGE score multiplier!
But wait a minute!  ALL LOCKS are actually STINKY CHUZZLE!  And Stinky won't match!
list.note: rendered with the <_stinky> red/yellow blink tag instead of <_tc>, always paired with a lock-related rule above it

list.text: Matching FOUR chuzzles creates a super Chuzzle too!
Combo matches create a Super Chuzzle!
Matching %s CHUZZLES will %s scores for the turn!
list.note: templated: %s slots are filled with a colour name and a multiplier word (double/triple/quadruple), chosen elsewhere in SetRules

tags._readme: the custom markup defined at the top of every Today's Rules panel
tags._tc: color .8,.8,1,.85 - the default readable body text colour
tags.blinky: blink color=.8,1,1;color=.8,.8,1,.75;time=30; - cyan/blue pulse for emphasis
tags._stinky: blink color=1,1,.5;color=1,.5,.5,.75;time=30; - yellow/red pulse for warnings
